signature: boxShapes(keys: readonly ShapeKey[], opts?: BoxShapesOptions): TLShapeId
summary: Draw a labelled container behind a set of shapes and return its id.

fields.name: label
fields.doc: Container label. An unlabelled container is a plain grouping mark.

fields.name: margin
fields.doc: Distance from the container's edge to the outermost shape, default 40.

fields.name: color
fields.doc: Outline colour, default `grey`.

fields.name: dash
fields.doc: Outline style, default `draw`.

fields.name: size
fields.doc: Label size, default `s`.

fields.name: shapeId
fields.doc: The container's own key. Derived from the label when omitted.

fields.name: minW
fields.doc: Smallest width the container may have, whatever its members need.

fields.name: minH
fields.doc: Smallest height the container may have, whatever its members need.

fields.name: matchSize
fields.doc: Another container to end up the same size as. Both grow to the larger width and the larger height, each keeping its own top-left corner, so two panels being compared read as two panels rather than as one big and one small. Use `alignContainers` for three or more.

fields.name: meta
fields.doc: Extra metadata. `container: true` is always set on top of it.

name: clear

summary: Delete every shape on the current page and return how many went.

fields.name: force
fields.doc: Wipe a page this snippet did not create. Say so on purpose.

summary: Lay existing shapes out top to bottom and return their ids in order.

fields.name: gap
fields.doc: Gap between neighbours, default 40.

fields.name: align
fields.doc: Alignment on the cross axis, default `start`.

fields.name: x
fields.doc: Page x the line begins at. Defaults to the first shape's current x.

fields.name: y
fields.doc: Page y the line begins at. Defaults to the first shape's current y.

name: connect
signature: connect(from: ShapeKey, to: ShapeKey, opts?: ConnectOptions): TLShapeId
summary: Draw an arrow bound at both ends and return its id.

fields.name: id
fields.doc: Override the derived arrow key. Needed only for a second arrow between the same pair of shapes, since the derived id would collide.

fields.name: label
fields.doc: Arrow label.

fields.name: kind
fields.doc: `elbow` for right-angled segments (default), `arc` for a straight or curved line.

fields.name: start
fields.doc: Where the arrow leaves the source. A side name, `{ x, y }` in 0..1, or omitted for auto.

fields.name: end
fields.doc: Where the arrow meets the target. Same forms as `start`.

fields.name: bend
fields.doc: Curvature, `arc` only, default 0.

fields.name: mid
fields.doc: Where the bend lands along an elbow path, 0..1, default 0.5. Use it to keep parallel arrows in separate lanes.

fields.name: head
fields.doc: Which ends get a head, default `end`.

fields.name: labelPosition
fields.doc: Label position along the arrow, 0..1, default 0.5.

fields.name: color
fields.doc: Line colour, default `black`.

fields.name: labelColor
fields.doc: Label colour, defaults to `color`.

fields.name: size
fields.doc: Line weight, default `s`.

fields.name: dash
fields.doc: Line style, default `draw`.

fields.name: font
fields.doc: Label font, default `draw`.

fields.name: precise
fields.doc: Force precise anchoring on or off for both ends. Both ends are precise by default, named or not, because an imprecise binding ignores the anchor and aims at the shape's centre, which throws away the alignment `autoAnchors` just worked out. Pass `false` to hand the entry point back to tldraw's own router.

fields.name: meta
fields.doc: Arbitrary record metadata. `lintIgnore` lives here.

name: describe

summary: Everything on the current page: the same structure `inspect` prints.

summary: Fit the camera to every shape and return the bounds it framed.

fields.name: padding
fields.doc: Room to leave around the shapes. Without it this is a plain `zoomToFit`.

name: getLints
signature: getLints(): Lint[]
summary: Run the lint pass over the current page and return the findings. Nine shape rules: `friendless-arrow`, `arrow-crosses-shape`, `line-crosses-label`, `overlapping-text`, `overlapping-shapes`, `off-page`, `empty-label`, `unreadable-label` and `missing-glyph`, plus `missing-topic` on the document.

fields.name: y

name: line
signature: line(key: ShapeKey, x1: number, y1: number, x2: number, y2: number, opts?: DrawLineOptions): TLShapeId
summary: Draw an unbound line from one page point to another and return its id.

fields.name: color
fields.doc: Line colour, default `black`.

fields.name: size
fields.doc: Line weight, default `s`.

fields.name: dash
fields.doc: Line style, default `draw`.

fields.name: head
fields.doc: Which ends get an arrowhead, default `none`. `end`, `start`, `both`.

fields.name: kind
fields.doc: `arc` (default) for a straight or curved line, `elbow` for right-angled segments.

fields.name: bend
fields.doc: Curvature, `arc` only, default 0. Positive bends a quarter turn anticlockwise from the direction of travel.

fields.name: label
fields.doc: A label on the line. Empty by default, which is what a bare axis or rule wants.

fields.name: labelColor
fields.doc: Label colour, defaults to `color`.

fields.name: parent
fields.doc: A frame or group to parent to. The points given stay page coordinates; the helper converts them.

fields.name: lintIgnore
fields.doc: Override the muted rules. An array of rule names, or `true` for all of them. Defaults to `LINE_LINT_IGNORE`; pass `[]` to have the line linted like any other arrow.

fields.name: meta
fields.doc: Arbitrary record metadata. `lintIgnore` is merged over it.

signature: mermaid(source: string, opts: MermaidOptions = {}): ApplyPlanResult

fields.name: direction

fields.doc: Gap inside a rank, default 60.

fields.name: margin
fields.doc: Margin between a subgraph container and its members, default 40.

fields.name: respace
fields.doc: Re-space the ranks against the measured shapes, default `true`. `false` leaves the plan's own coordinates alone: debugging only, expect overlaps.
